note: Recorded from the hand-written pack in the commit that deleted it. Every expectation describes that pack, not the real service; a probe run replaces cells with observed evidence and cites the cassette. Where the pack answered a member the operation's own output shape does not declare (UpdateAddon's addon, UpdateCapability's capability, AssociateEncryptionConfig's cluster, DescribeInsightsRefresh's insightRefresh), the bundle answers the declared shape and the step is superseded with that reason.

steps.superseded: the pack answered {addon: <record>}; UpdateAddonResponse declares only `update`, which the pack never set, so the bundle answers nothing
the pack answered {capability: <record>}; UpdateCapabilityResponse declares only `update`, which the pack never set, so the bundle answers nothing
the pack answered {cluster: <patched record>}; AssociateEncryptionConfigResponse declares only `update`, which the pack never set, so the bundle answers nothing
the pack answered {insightRefresh: [...]}; DescribeInsightsRefreshResponse declares endedAt, message, startedAt and status -- no insightRefresh member -- so the bundle answers nothing
